labs.research_summary: A Harvard Graduate School of Education lab that researches and designs ways to help PK-12 educators build computer science learning around self-direction and self-expression.
labs.member_breakdown: 1 faculty director, 2 doctoral students, 1 research associate
labs.notes: One visiting scholar (Paulina Haduong) is listed and not counted; a long alumni list is not counted. Page invites people to join via degree programs, courses or by email; no jobs page.
